title: Define AI disclosure rules
scope: Every published Recording created through 420Hz Generate must bind exactly one stable disclosure class and a versioned disclosure commitment.

classes.meaning: No generative AI contribution is claimed in the published composition or master.
allowedWhen: Generate/project tooling may have been opened, but no generative output is materially incorporated into the published Work or Recording
non-generative editing, deterministic processing, metering, storage, indexing, mastering tools or ordinary automation do not by themselves require an AI disclosure class
forbiddenWhen: generated melody, harmony, lyrics, arrangement, voice, instrumental performance, stem or audible master content is materially incorporated
a pre-existing Work or Recording was transformed/remixed by a generative model

classes.meaning: AI materially assisted the creative/production process, but the published composition/master does not contain substantial generated musical, lyrical, vocal or performance content.
allowedWhen: AI was used for ideation, critique, tagging, arrangement suggestions, cleanup/restoration assistance, timing suggestions or other assistive workflow
any retained generated contribution is incidental/non-substantial and does not become the defining composition, vocal, instrumental performance or substantial master content
forbiddenWhen: substantial generated composition or audible performance/master content is retained
the release is a generative transformation/remix of a pre-existing source

classes.meaning: The published Work or Recording contains substantial AI-generated composition, lyrics, vocal/instrumental performance, stems or other audible/generated master content and is not classified as AI_DERIVATIVE.
allowedWhen: generated musical/compositional material materially forms the Work
generated vocal/instrumental/audio content materially forms the Recording
the creator curates, edits, performs over or mixes generated material but substantial generated content remains in the released result
forbiddenWhen: the defining AI operation is a transformation/remix of a pre-existing source requiring derivative authorization; AI_DERIVATIVE takes precedence

classes.meaning: The published result is created by generative transformation/remix of an existing Work or Recording and therefore requires source authorization under the Creative Protocol.
allowedWhen: a generative model transforms, remixes, revoices, restyles, stem-processes or otherwise derives from an existing Work/Recording in a way requiring source authorization
Creative RecordingClass is AI_DERIVATIVE or the source/reference authorization path establishes an AI transformation derivative
forbiddenWhen: no source Work/Recording requiring derivative authorization exists

precedence: AI_DERIVATIVE overrides AI_GENERATED when generative output is based on a pre-existing source requiring derivative authorization
AI_GENERATED overrides AI_ASSISTED when substantial generated compositional or audible/performance content is retained
AI_ASSISTED overrides HUMAN whenever material generative assistance contributed to the released creative/production process
HUMAN is valid only when none of the AI-assisted/generated/derivative conditions apply

substantialityRule.policy: No fixed percentage threshold is invented at HZ-GCA-1.4. Substantiality is determined by whether generated material forms a meaningful compositional, lyrical, vocal, instrumental, stem or audible-master contribution to the released result.
substantialityRule.failClosed: If classification between AI_ASSISTED and AI_GENERATED is genuinely unresolved at publication review, Generate publication must fail closed pending correction rather than default to HUMAN.
substantialityRule.futureVersioning: A later governed/versioned policy may introduce more objective thresholds, but cannot rewrite historical disclosure meaning without an explicit new disclosure-policy version.

publicationBinding.bindAt: before or atomically with publication handoff; publication may not complete without a valid disclosure commitment
publicationBinding.immutableHistory: the disclosure commitment bound to a published Recording/version is historical metadata and cannot be silently overwritten
publicationBinding.correction: a correction requires an explicit new disclosure revision/version with prior value retained and current presentation clearly identifying the superseding disclosure
publicationBinding.withdrawal: withdrawal/restriction of a Recording does not erase historical disclosure

sourceEvidenceRules: Disclosure is not inferred from provider marketing copy, model name, UI labels, Search tags, chart placement or popularity.
420AI Model420 aiDisclosureHash describes the model/version disclosure metadata; it does not determine a Recording's HUMAN/AI_ASSISTED/AI_GENERATED/AI_DERIVATIVE class.
A provider or model declaring itself 'human-like', 'assistive', 'original' or similar cannot downgrade the Recording disclosure class.
The recording disclosure is declared/reviewed against the actual generation/provenance/source-authority record.
rightsBoundaries: Disclosure is descriptive metadata, not proof of copyright ownership, authorship, license validity, consent or legal status.
AI_DERIVATIVE requires the applicable Creative source Work/Recording/License authorization path; the label itself grants no permission.
AI transformation permission remains distinct from AI training permission.
HUMAN does not certify absence of all software automation; it only states no material generative AI contribution under this policy.
AI_GENERATED or AI_ASSISTED does not waive contributor rights, royalty rights or provenance requirements.

creativeMapping.otherRecordingClasses: may disclose HUMAN, AI_ASSISTED or AI_GENERATED if consistent with actual process; recording class alone does not fully determine disclosure
creativeMapping.provenanceClass: does not substitute for disclosure class
creativeMapping.rightsStatus: does not substitute for disclosure class

lifecycleIntegration.SUBMITTED: provisional disclosure may exist but is not publication-bound
lifecycleIntegration.RUNNING: provisional disclosure may be updated from actual job/source path
lifecycleIntegration.SUCCEEDED: one candidate disclosure must be determinable from the successful output/source path before REVIEWED
lifecycleIntegration.REVIEWED: creator explicitly confirms the disclosure as part of review/provenance handoff
lifecycleIntegration.REGISTERED: disclosure commitment must remain bound to the exact Work/Recording handoff data
lifecycleIntegration.PUBLISHED: exactly one valid disclosure class is public and bound to the published Recording/version

privacyRules: Public disclosure class does not require publishing plaintext prompts, private lyrics drafts, raw reference audio, model secrets or provider credentials.
Public disclosure may reference commitments/IDs sufficient for provenance without exposing protected payloads.
Private draft disclosure deliberation remains non-indexable until publication policy makes the final disclosure public.
validationFailures: HUMAN when generated content is materially retained
AI_ASSISTED when substantial generated content is materially retained
AI_GENERATED when derivative transformation of a protected/pre-existing source requires AI_DERIVATIVE
attempt to derive Recording disclosure solely from Model420 aiDisclosureHash/provider marketing
attempt to overwrite historical disclosure in place
attempt to use disclosure as rights/license/training permission
invariants: HZGCA-DISC-001 every published Generate-origin Recording binds exactly one disclosure class
HZGCA-DISC-002 allowed disclosure vocabulary is exactly HUMAN, AI_ASSISTED, AI_GENERATED, AI_DERIVATIVE
HZGCA-DISC-003 AI_DERIVATIVE has precedence over AI_GENERATED for generative transformations of pre-existing sources requiring authorization
HZGCA-DISC-004 AI_GENERATED has precedence over AI_ASSISTED when substantial generated composition or audible/performance content remains
HZGCA-DISC-005 AI_ASSISTED has precedence over HUMAN when material generative assistance contributed to the release
HZGCA-DISC-006 unresolved classification at publication fails closed and never defaults to HUMAN
HZGCA-DISC-007 provider/model marketing or Model420 aiDisclosureHash cannot independently determine Recording disclosure
HZGCA-DISC-008 disclosure metadata never grants rights, licenses, consent, custody, payment or governance authority
HZGCA-DISC-009 AI transformation authorization remains distinct from AI training permission
HZGCA-DISC-010 RecordingClass AI_DERIVATIVE requires disclosure AI_DERIVATIVE
HZGCA-DISC-011 provenanceClass and rightsStatus do not substitute for disclosure
HZGCA-DISC-012 REVIEWED requires explicit creator confirmation of candidate disclosure
HZGCA-DISC-013 PUBLISHED requires one valid public disclosure bound to the exact Recording/version
HZGCA-DISC-014 disclosure correction is append-only/versioned and preserves historical values
HZGCA-DISC-015 public disclosure does not require disclosure of private prompts, drafts, reference payloads or secrets
HZGCA-DISC-016 disclosure classification cannot bypass provenance, consent, derivative authorization, registration or publication gates
exitCriteria: the four disclosure classes and their meanings are explicit
classification precedence and fail-closed ambiguity handling are explicit
publication-time binding and correction/versioning semantics are explicit
Model420/provider disclosure is separated from Recording disclosure
Creative RecordingClass/rights/provenance relationships are explicit without duplicating authority
privacy and non-rights-grant boundaries are explicit
machine verifier enforces vocabulary, precedence, publication and authority invariants
no ABI, contract deployment, provider integration or testnet claim is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.5 through HZ-GCA-1.20
